==Description==
The '''Present2''' was an enemy that first appeared in the second phase of [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had a low amount of health and average speed. Upon death, it would spawn a [[Present (Krampus Frosthold)|Present]], which had less health, but had defense and is faster than it.

It could be spawned by the [[Present3 (Krampus Frosthold)|Present3]] upon its death.

==Appearance==
The '''Present2''' was a humanoid present. The wrapping paper was a pattern of white dots equally distanced from each other, with a green background behind them. There was a white ribbon going across its head and torso, as well as a big white bow on its chest.

==Strategy==
*Area of effect towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Mortar]] or [[Golden Pyromancer]] can be very useful against this and the [[Present (Krampus Frosthold)|Present]] it spawns, as the '''Present2''' generally spawns in hordes.
*High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Engineer]] can be useful against this.
